website.description: WIP Dalamud plugin for debuffs on the enemy list
website.readme_excerpt:
# EnemyListDebuffs
This plugin provides a graphical debuff icon with countdown timer on your enmity list, making it easier to track your debuffs and DoTs in multi-target scenarios.

## This is the active fork that is being maintained within Dalamud's main repo
